## Source maintenance

CogineX 0.2.0 prepares native account integration and five shared skills on 2026-10-30. It
connects

directly to the existing CogineX MCP server, exposes its full toolset,
and includes account setup, t

ask, knowledge and collaboration guidance, plus a source capability review and known gaps. See its
i

nstallation and acceptance notes. This checkout
prepares the plugin; remote catalog availability dep
ends on publication.

Product 0.2.4 adds `ux-audit` (产品 UX 巡检) on 2026-10-11. It walks an existing
product against a desig

n principle and reports its 3–5 strongest violations
with screenshots or labeled schematics. Refresh

the Marketplace and update
the Product Manager plugin to use the new skill.

The 2026-10-08 source prepared Coding 0.2.5, Growth 0.1.6, Product 0.2.3,
Design 0.1.5, Sales 0.1.2,

and Founder/CEO 0.1.3. The upstream wave is recorded in each
bundle's `UPSTREAM_SYNC_2026-10-08.jso

n`; Coding's bounded Power Gates repair
is recorded separately in `LOCAL_MAINTENANCE_2026-10-08.json

`.
Maintenance sources and consumer aliases identify
the editable source, host overlays, and safe du

plicate-entry transitions.
Standalone repairs retain exact
patches and hashes for existing local ent

ries without changing installer locks.
Cursourcing remains 0.2.3. See CHANGELOG.md for the changes;
prepared source versions do not imply a published or installed update.
## Compatibility

Codex is the primary target. CogineX and the six role-based plugins also ship
native Claude Code man
ifests while sharing the same skill folders:

- Codex catalog: `.agents/plugins/marketplace.json`
- Codex manifests: `plugins/*/.codex-plugin/plug

in.json`
- Claude Code catalog: `.claude-plugin/marketplace.json`
- Claude Code manifests: `plugins/
*/.claude-plugin/plugin.json`
## Update
### Codex
[代码示例省略，未执行]

Confirm that the plugins you updated report the expected versions. For
Cursourcing, run `codex plugi

n add cursourcing@cogine-ai` after refreshing the
marketplace, then check for version `0.2.3` in `co

dex plugin list --json`.
Start a new task after upgrading so its skill index is rebuilt.
### Claude Code
[代码示例省略，未执行]
Restart Claude Code after the plugin update so the new version is loaded.
## Repository layout
[代码示例省略，未执行]

Cursourcing is maintained in cogine-ai/cursourcing.
This repository carries its installable release

snapshot; see the plugin's
`UPSTREAM.md` for the pinned source commit.
## Good Offence candidate — 2026-10-28

Coding 0.2.6 adds `coding-engineer-skills:good-offence`, focused guidance for
reviewing unnecessary

defensive implementations. Agents choose how to investigate
and judge the target code; examples and

optional references support that work.
The Marketplace maintains the skill, and auto-agents carries

a reviewed copy
with legacy invocation metadata. Development cases remain outside the package.
